column1: # p347 — ACTION ZZ-q executed.  ZZ-q asked whether extending every licence ladder to the
# ORTHOGRAPHY and EXTENSION axes recovers any grant this base currently publishes as absent.
# It does, and the pass found a cheaper fix than more rungs: PIN THE HEAD SHA and enumerate
# the TREE.  Pinning dissolves the REF axis entirely (no main/master/develop ladder is needed
# at all); enumeration dissolves the FILENAME axis (case, spelling, extension) AND the DEPTH
# METHOD, per address: (1) `git ls-remote --symref` for existence, default ref and HEAD sha;
# filtered on licen[cs]e|copying|notice; (3) a 12-rung ROOT ladder fetched over
# raw.githubusercontent.com AT THE PINNED SHA, for comparison with (2).
# recovered_by: LADDER = an extended root ladder at the pin finds it.  TREE-ONLY = only
# enumeration finds it (the path is at depth, or LICENSE is a directory).  NEITHER = no
# licence-shaped path exists at the pin, which CONFIRMS this base's published no-grant cell.
# 🔴 TREE-ONLY is NOT the same as "the repository is licensed" — see ACTION ZZ-v: a grant at
# `packages/x/LICENSE` licenses that package, not the root.
# 🔴 WHEN THE TWO DEPTH-RECOVERED GRANTS WERE ADDED, read from each repository's own
# `git log --diff-filter=A -- '*LICENSE*'` this pass.  This settles whether the earlier
# depth probes on these shelves missed them or predated them:
# Both predate the shelf's own commit reads of those repositories (heads 2026-07-10 and
# 2026-09-20) and both predate the "depth axis, 80 paths" and "24 case-varied rungs"
# re-probes that recorded `no nested grant` / `absent on all 24 rungs`.
# 🟢 So 80 composed paths at depth is still a LADDER: it must GUESS the directory name.
# `ls-tree -r HEAD` guesses nothing and returns `canvas-lms-mcp/` and `packages/xapi/`.
# Re-read benches for the two re-graded rows (bare blobless clone, this pass):
# likr/canvas-lms-agent   68 c · likr-lab.com(68) · +0900(68) · head 2026-07-10 ⇒ APAC - Japan (no DST, non-shifting offset expected)
# studiolxd/xapi          12 c · studiolxd.com(12) · +0200(12) · head 2026-09-20 ⇒ EMEA, offset UNTESTABLE (all 12 commits inside Mar-Nov)
